verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's docs say it is backed by the full Ubuntu archive for packages and updates, and that each release ships the latest applications, libraries and toolchains. That shows the packages and runtimes exist, but nothing shows a single command that provisions a complete developer environment. missing for 10: a documented single-command dev setup (e.g. a meta-package or provisioning tool), any description of how packages and runtimes are installed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
